newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi, Chevron to build petrochem plant.
newsitem.headline: Saudi, Chevron to build petrochem plant.

text.p: A Chevron Corp and Saudi Arabian joint venture will on March 29 lay the foundation stone of a $650 million petrochemical plant in the Saudi industrial city of Jubail, the Saudi Arab News newspaper said on Tuesday.
It said officials from the joint venture between Chevron and the Saudi Industrial Venture Capital Group -- called Saudi Chevron Petrochemical -- had recently approved the plant's site.
The joint venture said in September construction of the 480,000 tonne-per-year benzene plant and a 220,000 tonne-per-year cyclohexane unit is due to be completed in mid-1999.
The plant will manufacture benzene from a natural gasoline feedstock supplied by Saudi Aramco.
